# Zevylo

> Zevylo is a free collection of 213 browser-based utilities across 18 categories, plus a directory of 305 AI products across 23 categories.

- Canonical URL: https://zevylo.netlify.app
- Creator: Muhammad Daniyal (https://github.com/daniyal44)
- Contact: m.daniyalkhan490@gmail.com
- Content last reviewed: 2026-11-20

## How the site works

Most Zevylo tools read the selected file or pasted text inside the browser page and process it there. No account is required and there is no upload queue for those tools. A few tools open a third-party website or require a network request (for example, fetching a URL the user supplies); the tool page states this where it applies.

The site is hosted on Netlify. The contact form is delivered through Netlify Forms. Google AdSense is installed on the site; no ad units are currently displayed while the publisher account is under review.

## What the site does not claim

- Not "100% private" and not "zero bytes ever leave the device". Hosting logs, the contact form, advertising, and a small number of network-dependent tools involve data leaving the browser.
- No unlimited file sizes. Practical limits depend on the device, browser memory, and the format.
- Re-encoding to JPEG, WebP, MP3, MP4 and similar lossy formats reduces quality; it is not lossless.
- No claim to bypass or defeat AI detectors.
- AI directory listings are compiled from public information. They are not independently benchmarked, rated, or ranked.

## AI directory (305 listings, 23 categories)

https://zevylo.netlify.app/ai-tools

Listings include a short description, pricing model, features, limitations, and a link to the vendor's official site. Pricing and features change; confirm them with the vendor. The directory does not publish traffic figures, star ratings, review counts, or benchmark scores.
